Cufant card values: compare the set and full number

2026-11-05

A Cufant Pokemon card can be a regular numbered card or a different artwork and finish from another part of a set. Start with the set and full collector number. Shrouded Fable 041/064 and 076/064 are separate Cufant printings, while Shining Fates: Shiny Vault uses SV090/SV122.

Selected English Cufant card values

The Card AI catalog returned these records in the November 5, 2026 lookup:

These samples do not specify a raw condition or slab grade. They are separate published record references, not a single Cufant price range, offers or guaranteed resale values. This is a selected comparison, not a full checklist of Cufant cards or every finish.

Why the set and finish matter

Do not apply the 076/064 reference to a 041/064 copy just because both names say Cufant. Match the artwork and printed number. Keep the SV prefix when searching for the Shiny Vault card; dropping it can point to a different numbered entry.

The catalog finish shown in this table belongs to that record. If your physical copy has a different treatment or language, locate its own record rather than assuming the same sample applies. An unavailable finish price remains unavailable.

How to check your Cufant card

In the Card AI app, search for Cufant with the set or full number. Alternatively, use the Pokemon card scanner and review the likely matches. Confirm the printing, finish and language before selecting raw condition or an existing slab grade.

Open the card price checker to review that record's available price and history. A low catalog sample is not proof of a real sale price after shipping, fees or condition differences. Save confirmed copies to your collection if you own them.

For another character with several numbered versions, compare Ivysaur card values. The Pokemon card value index provides other selected references, while the set card list guide explains how to read a whole set's numbering.

Source: Card AI Cufant catalog lookup, retrieved November 5, 2026. The website shows dated references; personal collection actions remain in the app.
